# Md. Yaleed Haque

## Profile
C#/.NET and Kotlin developer in Dhaka, Bangladesh (roots in Pabna and Dinajpur). Builds local-first software: virtual input devices, offline multiplayer systems, and AI desktop automation. Work close to the metal — UDP sockets, Win32 APIs, sensor streams — with no cloud dependency.

## Projects
- GamePadEcosystem: Android phones as wireless Xbox 360 controllers for Windows PC. Zero cloud, sub-5ms latency, up to 8 players. C#/.NET 8 server + Kotlin/Compose client. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/GamePadEcosystem
- StarkAgent: AI desktop control agent with 275+ commands over a local TCP/JSON API. C#/.NET 8, Win32, OCR. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/StarkAgent
- dgll: Distributed Graph Learning Library. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/dgll
- Edge-project: Experimental front-end work. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/Edge-project

## Tech Stack
C# (.NET 8), Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), Android, Windows Win32, ViGEm, SendInput, UDP/TCP networking, HTML.
